gait_speed_frailty_cutoff.context: Common gait-speed threshold associated with impaired mobility / frailty risk.

hba1c_target.canonical_reference: American Diabetes Association. Standards of Care in Diabetes. Diabetes Care. 2024;47(Suppl 1).

hba1c_intensive_target.context: Tighter HbA1c target for younger / lower-risk patients.
hba1c_intensive_target.canonical_reference: American Diabetes Association. Standards of Care in Diabetes. Diabetes Care. 2024;47(Suppl 1).

bmi_overweight.canonical_reference: World Health Organization. Obesity: Preventing and Managing the Global Epidemic. WHO Technical Report Series 894. 2000.

bmi_obese.canonical_reference: World Health Organization. Obesity: Preventing and Managing the Global Epidemic. WHO Technical Report Series 894. 2000.

metformin_standard_dose.context: Common upper-end daily metformin dose for type 2 diabetes.

ms_to_aging_decline.context: Annual age-related gait-speed decline in older adults.
